_usage: Administrator skill revocations (tools/skills_revocations.py). Add an entry to the 'entries' list; an entry matches when EVERY field it names matches. Fields: id (skill name), version, digest ('sha256:<16 or 64 hex>' — the full content digest, matched by prefix so a 16-hex form also works), source ('official', 'github', ...), plus an optional 'reason'. Entry examples: {"id": "bad-skill"}, {"id": "bad-skill", "version": "1.2.0"}, {"digest": "sha256:aaaaaaaabbbbbbbbccccccccdddddddd"}, {"id": "bad-skill", "reason": "creator shipped malicious variant"}. Install-time matches are HARD blocks; --force does NOT override a revocation. Runtime reads ~/.hermes/skills-revocations.json (HERMES_SKILLS_REVOCATIONS override); this repo copy is the admin record — copy/sync it into place with git.
_empty_by_default: Ship with an empty list; entries come from you (admin) only.
